Entries.Text: Model Save Check

Problems found in the models the save was about to write. Click an object to select it, fix what is listed, then check again. Errors make the save fail or write a model the game can't use; warnings are saved, but are probably mistakes; information is for things vanilla models do too.

Actions
Check the same models again, save, or close this window.
Check Again
Runs the check again on the same models, after you have fixed some of the problems.
Save
Runs the save that was stopped.
Save Anyway
Runs the save that was stopped, without checking. A model that can't be written still fails to save, and the log says why.
Close
Closes this window without saving.
Problems
Errors first, then warnings and notes, by model.
Show Warnings
Lists the warnings as well as the errors.
Show Notes
Lists the notes too: things vanilla models also do, such as dummies sharing a reference ID. They never stop a save.

Check Models Before Saving

Before Save or Save All writes anything, checks the models it will write: indices out of range, vertex bones, node links, the skeleton set, and Demon's Souls limits. Errors stop the save and open the Model Save Check window. Autosaves aren't checked.
Stop on Warnings
Warnings stop the save too, not only errors.
Check Model Now
Checks the loaded model and shows the result in the Model Save Check window, without saving.
